description: Hand-authored routing expectations for the public reduced-stack ruleset, replayed by scripts/ruleset_check.py through the real resolver. The minimality probe is the F4-style tripwire: adding a rule that routes an unrelated documentation task fails this file until the expectation is deliberately updated. Host installations add their own probes file for project-override (F2) cases.

probes.description: An unrelated documentation typo fix must load only the always-on kernel: entrypoint, repo router, base role.
probes.task_text: Correct a typo in the contribution guide wording.

probes.description: Any planned C# mutation must pull the C# code-change family; a neutral task text must not pull keyword families.
probes.task_text: Adjust the widget component implementation details.

probes.description: Real threading vocabulary in the task itself must route the async/threading family.
probes.task_text: Move the upload continuation off the main thread using async scheduling.

probes.description: High risk class must route the high-risk contract and routing-gate families regardless of vocabulary.
probes.task_text: Adjust the widget component implementation details.

probes.description: Triaging a production exception whose stack has no application frame must load the detached-callback attribution doctrine alongside the async family.
probes.task_text: Attribute a production ObjectDisposedException from a UniTask timer callback whose stacktrace shows only PlayerLoopRunner frames and no application frame; every sample is an identical stacktrace and the async teardown owner is unknown.
